notes: Official results begin with the first clean baseline run. This file replaces the original cloud-environment status artifact so the repository no longer claims the target environment is unavailable.
known_limitations: Nsight tools may be limited by the WSL2 GPU virtualization environment.
Tensor Core WMMA path requires M, N, and K divisible by 16.
CPU verification may be impractical for very large GEMMs and can be explicitly disabled with --no-verify.
